meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 直接生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据书名和作者名自动生成专业小说封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速为小说生成带标题和署名的封面图
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional novel covers from book title and author name
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate a cover image with title and author for your novel

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按书名和作者名判断小说题材，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的封面图，先给 2-3 个构图方案，并保存为 PNG 及提示词副本。
howto.when: 当你说“/story-cover”“/封面”或“帮我做个封面”“生成封面图”等指令时触发。

say.text: 帮我做个封面，书名《剑来》，作者名烽火
say.note: 会先判断题材，再生成几个构图方案

say.text: 生成封面图，平台番茄小说，参考这张图
say.note: 会走图生图并导出上传尺寸

say.text: 换个悬疑风格，重做这个封面

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will infer the genre from the book title and author name, then call GPT-Image-2 to generate a cover with title and author name. It first presents 2-3 composition options and saves the PNG plus prompt copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/story-cover", "/封面", or phrases like "帮我做个封面" or "生成封面图".

say_en.text: Make me a cover for book title '剑来' by author '烽火'
say_en.note: It will infer genre and offer composition options

say_en.text: Generate a cover for Tomato Novel, using this reference image
say_en.note: It will use image-to-image and export upload size

say_en.text: Change to a mystery style and redo this cover
say_en.note: It will adjust the style and regenerate
